creates Magic Planning item and path optimisation jobs; the plan is not saved

preconditions.text: CT account logged in on W044
MagicPlanning and MagicPlanningItemsOptimisation on for the CT account (step 7 records and asserts both)

requirement.text: Magic Planning: area splitting and flight direction (CL-80001). Optimize flight on a hilly area may split it and/or change its flight direction; the result is applied unsaved and the toast names what changed.

routing.why: items flag read per attempt; off = path optimisation only (227-232); 10 min deadline (46)
import creates a new flight in the chosen site (createFlight), planned when it has an area and a takeoff
shown with MagicPlanning on and MapTilerTerrainSource off, for a planned editable flight

steps.text: Give the dialog the plan file (file chooser intercepted)
Import: creates the QA_ flight in the QA site (cloud write) and opens the planner
Wait until the planner shows Optimize flight (up to 60 s)

assert.expr: v['before']['magic_planning'] is True and v['before']['items_flag'] is True and v['before']['button'] is True and len(v['before']['server_areas']) == 1

steps.read_js: (async () => { const h = {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('accessToken')}; const id = location.pathname.split('/').pop(); const f = await (await fetch('https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/flights/' + id, {headers: h})).json(); const items = (((f.flightPlan || {}).flightPlan) || {}).items || []; const areas = items.filter(i => i.complexItemType === 'area').map(a => ({angle: (a.grid || {}).angle, alt: (a.grid || {}).altitude, gsd: (a.camera || {}).groundResolution})); let u = null; try { u = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('unleashFlags') || 'null'); } catch (e) {} const tg = Array.isArray(u) ? u : ((u && u.toggles) || []); const on = n => tg.some(t => t && t.name === n && t.enabled !== false); window.__qaToasts = []; window.__qaT0 = Date.now(); const re = /Flight successfully optimi[sz]ed|No further improvements found|Failed to optimi[sz]e flight|Optimi[sz]ation takes too long|Split areas|Adjusted flight direction|Optimized transit/i; if (window.__qaObs) window.__qaObs.disconnect(); window.__qaObs = new MutationObserver(() => { for (const m of (document.body.innerText.match(new RegExp(re.source, 'gi')) || [])) if (!window.__qaToasts.includes(m)) window.__qaToasts.push(m); }); window.__qaObs.observe(document.body, {subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true}); const rows = [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && /^A\d+\s*-\s*Area/.test(e.innerText || '')).map(e => e.innerText.trim()))]; return {flight_id: id, status: f.flightPlanStatus, title: f.title, server_areas: areas, rows: rows.length, magic_planning: on('MagicPlanning'), items_flag: on('MagicPlanningItemsOptimisation'), button: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=magic-planning-entry-point]')}; })()
steps.text: Before: flags, area rows, the server's areas; start recording the Magic Planning messages

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:magic-planning-entry-point --find-timeout 30 --expect "js:/Locked \(optimizing\)|optimi[sz]ed|No further improvements|Failed to optimi|takes too long/i.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 20
steps.text: Optimize flight (creates the optimisation jobs; cloud write)

steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:(window.__qaToasts || []).some(x => /Flight successfully optimi|No further improvements|Failed to optimi|takes too long/i.test(x)) || Date.now() - (window.__qaT0 || 0) > 70000" --timeout 80

assert.expr: v['after']['success'] is True and v['after']['failed'] is False and v['after']['server_areas'] == len(v['before']['server_areas']) and v['after']['split_toast'] == (v['after']['rows'] > v['before']['rows'])

steps.read_js: (async () => { const h = {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('accessToken')}; const id = location.pathname.split('/').pop(); const f = await (await fetch('https://api.staging.company.example/api/v1/flights/' + id, {headers: h})).json(); const items = (((f.flightPlan || {}).flightPlan) || {}).items || []; const rows = [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && /^A\d+\s*-\s*Area/.test(e.innerText || '')).map(e => e.innerText.trim()))]; const t = window.__qaToasts || []; if (window.__qaObs) window.__qaObs.disconnect(); return {toasts: t, rows: rows.length, server_areas: items.filter(i => i.complexItemType === 'area').length, success: t.some(x => /Flight successfully optimi[sz]ed|No further improvements found/i.test(x)), failed: t.some(x => /Failed to optimi[sz]e|takes too long/i.test(x)), split_toast: t.some(x => /Split areas/i.test(x)), direction_toast: t.some(x => /Adjusted flight direction/i.test(x))}; })()
steps.text: After: messages, area rows, the server's areas (unsaved)
Clean-up: let a running optimisation finish before leaving (always; up to 80 s)

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20

steps.text: Exit without saving when asked (always; writes nothing)

steps_note: Written 2026-10-30 from qa/playbooks/flight-planning.md and the hand run of 2026-10-29 (tests/2026-10-29-magic-planning-cl80001). Splitting depends on the terrain the backend reads: a run that ends 'No further improvements found' passes but says the split was not exercised. The QA_ flight stays in the QA site (the engine does not delete); remove old ones by hand now and then. Direction changes are seen only through the toast (the unsaved plan's angles are not readable from the page). New case: a FAIL stays suspected until this version has passed once on the web. c1 (2026-10-30): the wait is up to 3 x 80 s (steps 9-11; run.py cuts a step at 90 s), and the clean-up waits for a running optimisation (step 13) before leaving. c2 (2026-10-30): the waits (steps 9-11) pass when the result is in or when their slot ends (70, 145, 220 s after step 7); step 12 asserts the outcome. c3 (2026-10-30): step 7 waits for the Optimize button before the 'before' read (now step 8); later steps are 1 higher.

supersedes.why: step 7 read the planner before it rendered (R-20261030-W044-PLAN-001-03 FAIL, Optimize button not there yet): a wait for the button now comes first
